headlines.description: Jürgen Klopp was denied a win in his first game in charge of Germany as his former Liverpool player Cody Gakpo secured a 1-1 draw for the Netherlands in stoppage time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Xavi, Klopp debut as Netherlands draw with Germany on Gakpo goal

headlines.description: Portugal edged Wales 1-0 in Lisbon to make a winning start to their UEFA Nations League campaign on what was a frustrating night for Cristiano Ronaldo.
